questions.question: How do I add my first transaction?
questions.answer: Go to Finance Tracker → the ➕ Add tab, choose income or expense, pick a category, enter the amount, and submit.

questions.question: Can I redo a Life Simulation from the start?
questions.answer: Yes — open Life Simulation and look for the restart option on the results screen once you finish a playthrough.

questions.question: Why is Unit 3 locked?
questions.answer: Only Unit 1 has full lessons written so far. Locked units show their lesson outline with a 🔒 until content is added.

questions.question: Is my data shared with anyone else?
questions.answer: No — everything you enter (tracker, simulation, course progress) is stored locally per account for this prototype.
